name: erss-dubai
description: ERSS Dubai — Emergency Response Support System for the Dubai Corporation for Ambulance Services

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.dev:lan: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev:lan -w web"
scripts.build: npm install --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build -w web
scripts.setup:db: npm run db:schema && npm run db:views && npm run seed
scripts.audit: npm run audit:theme && npm run audit:env
